notes: Footage camera moves were checked and left out (rule 1): push-in f1690-1712 (x~3.5), push f2147-2167, pull-back f2282-2307 (x~3.6). Spectral test: the close frames keep native detail above 0.35 Nyquist, so these are moves inside the footage, not digital scaling.
Caption groups are cut in with their shot: line 1 is already faintly visible in the first picture after the cuts at f1690 and f2052.
The caption layer is independent of the edit: during the whip f1748-1785 the footage whips but the caption keeps its slow linear drift and fades out.

Both headlines use the same extended heavy capitals with a continuous perspective size taper on a common baseline (headline 1 shrinks left->right 11.4 -> 6.1 %H, headline 2 grows left->right 5.9 -> 11.4 %H) and a vertical metallic gradient fill (headline 1: luma ~235 top -> ~165 bottom with a bright base rim; headline 2: ~200-208 top -> ~100-135 at the base, no rim).

Sound sync is loose: hard cuts sit -5, +15, -9 and +14 frames from the nearest beat (beat period 32.7 f); the morph start (-2), the second headline's 7th letter (-1) and caption lines C2 (+1), D1 (+2), D2 (+2 to a strong onset) land near beats/onsets; captions most likely follow the voice-over.
Pacing in this chunk: P01 part 90 f, P02 77 f, P03 58 f, P04 65 f, P05 162 f, P06 363 f; the graphic beats are short (65-90 f) between longer footage stretches.
Speaker icon of the X player (x 1545-1613, y 837-905) ignored everywhere.
Stills from earlier ad-hoc tags in this chunk were replaced by the final v5c3-P0n-m set.

Holds are not static here: the landed graphic group recedes linearly (-0.032 to -0.033 %/f) about the frame centre in P04 (f1837-1870) and P05 (f1892-2051, to 0.957 at the cut); the cursor and the background are separate layers that do not scale.

Two-phase entries: the P04 footage card and the P05 middle and right child cards all drift in slowly for 1-2 pictures, then snap with a hard ease-out; their curves cover the snap phase and the drift is given as measured values.

The P04 cursor fly-in (v5.cursor-fly-in) looks like the entry phase of v5c5's v5.cursor-glide-click (a cursor enters from a frame edge and decelerates onto a card); kept as its own id here for the merge to reconcile.
